title: Spring Design Co-op – Beauty House
note: Graphic design co-op in P&G's beauty design studio for students pursuing a BA/BS in Graphic Design; no immigration sponsorship.

facts.duties: Designs packaging, in-store, digital, eCommerce and social pieces for beauty brands such as Old Spice, Olay, Native and Pantene.
facts.requirements: Pursuing a BA/BS in Graphic Design; portfolio required and judged on creativity, storytelling and technical skill; Adobe Creative Suite; UX/UI knowledge and AI prototyping tools are a plus.
facts.apply: Apply on P&G's Workday posting; online assessments are part of the application.
